Description: Sets the server name displayed in the server browser. Use underscores (_) instead of spaces!

Game.ini MapNameOverride. Accepts Ancestral_Plains, Ancestral_Plains_Canvas, DM_Caldera, DM_Caldera_Canvas, Forest_Island, Forest_Island_Canvas, IslaTitania, MainMenuScreenMap_MP, Rival_Shores, Rival_Shores_Canvas, Temporal_Drift, Test_Performance, BB_Test_Map (QA), or Volcano_Bay. Test maps, Volcano Bay, and Scorched Valley may lack major shrines.
Sets whether to display the actual map name in the server browser, or instead the Custom Display Map Name. This does not change the map that is loaded.
Sets a custom map name to display in the server browser, if Use Custom Display Map Name is selected under Display Map Name Mode
Sets the game mode for the server (command line and Game.ini GameMode)

Browser/rules label only. PvP marks a deathmatch server (no gameplay effect). PvE marks a genetics/nesting/chill server. PvPvE is the default. Chill servers often keep PvPvE because of event and PvE-mode oversights. This field is not written by AMP Game.ini subsections. After Import, paste the full Key=value line into Additional ServerGameInstance Settings (or the leftover box for that heading) or the line is dropped.
Sets the password required for players to join the server

Password passed on the server command line as AdminPassword. This is not Game.ini ServerAdminPassword. If this command-line password is set and you do not know it, in-game commands will not work. Use Server Admin Passwords on the Administration tab for the Game.ini key.

Game.ini ServerAdminPassword. Accepts multiple passwords separated by commas. Leave blank to omit the line. Separate from the command-line Admin Password field. This field is not written by AMP Game.ini subsections. After Import, paste the full Key=value line into Additional ServerGameInstance Settings (or the leftover box for that heading) or the line is dropped.
Sets the maximum number of players that can connect to the server at one time
If enabled, players can open the Discord invite from the in-game interface. Requires Discord Invite Code to be set.

Invite code only, not the full URL (the part after discord.gg/). Shown in-game when Display Discord Link is enabled. AMP does not write DiscordLink=. Paste DiscordLink=YourCode into Additional ServerGameInstance Settings only when Display Discord Link is true.

Game.ini bRequireSteamGroupToJoin. The Steam group check is broken and currently prevents joining the server. Keep this false. If it is false you must omit Steam Group Name or the game treats the check as true.

Steam group unique name. The Steam group check is broken and currently prevents joining. Never write an empty SteamGroupName= line. If Require Steam Group To Join is false, omit this key. Paste SteamGroupName=YourGroup into Additional ServerGameInstance Settings only while that check is true.

Game.ini SteamWorkshopFoliageSaveItemIDs. Comma-separated workshop item IDs. Empty skips the line. This field is not written by AMP Game.ini subsections. After Import, paste the full Key=value line into Additional ServerGameInstance Settings (or the leftover box for that heading) or the line is dropped.

Game.ini GameServerLoginToken for Steam workshop foliage downloads. Empty skips the line. This field is not written by AMP Game.ini subsections. After Import, paste the full Key=value line into Additional ServerGameInstance Settings (or the leftover box for that heading) or the line is dropped.

Game.ini bUpdateFoliageFilesFromWorkshop. If false, the server keeps local workshop foliage copies. This field is not written by AMP Game.ini subsections. After Import, paste the full Key=value line into Additional ServerGameInstance Settings (or the leftover box for that heading) or the line is dropped.
Seconds between automatic saves. The game clamps this to a minimum of 30 seconds.
Food drain rate. Easy is half, Normal is default, Hard is double, Expert is triple.
Water drain rate. Easy is half, Normal is default, Hard is double, Expert is triple.
How quickly water becomes dirty. Easy is half, Normal is default, Hard is double, Expert is triple.

Multiplier for foliage spawn/regrowth relative to the normal rate. This field is not written by AMP Game.ini subsections. After Import, paste the full Key=value line into Additional ServerGameInstance Settings (or the leftover box for that heading) or the line is dropped.

Length of a full 24-hour in-game day in seconds. Default 7200. Day is 62.4% of this value and night is 37.6%. Examples: 3600 is a 1 hour cycle, 962 is a 10 minute day and 6 minute night. This field is not written by AMP Game.ini subsections. After Import, paste the full Key=value line into Additional ServerGameInstance Settings (or the leftover box for that heading) or the line is dropped.
Total meat spawned over time. Range 0 to 8. Default 1.0.
Size versus number of carcasses, 0 to 2. 2.0 (default) is tiny frequent carcasses. 0 is large rare carcasses.
Default true disables Restless. Set false to enable Restless, which punishes 100% shelter outside of poor weather, including light storms.
Default true disables random abandoned eggs. Set false to enable them. Abandoned eggs are not recommended on mixpacking or small servers and may be tied to a mixpacking group-visibility bug.
Chance a carcass spawn generates an abandoned egg. 0 stops egg spawns; 1 always spawns eggs instead of carcasses.

Game.ini TunnelNetworkDespawnTime: seconds until a tunnel despawns if nobody has dug in it. Guide default is 1800 (30 minutes). The game default is 259200 (3 days). Standing on assets such as BurrowBoulder02_C can cause DoS-level log spam for both server and client, so keep this timer low. Values below the 15 second server tick can lag or destabilize the server.
If true, portals are disabled. Palaeophis can cause CPU leaks at times when using portals.
If true, world events can spawn. Keep false unless you want events. Event chat in Global can become spammy.

Minutes from when a world event spawns until it starts. This field is not written by AMP Game.ini subsections. After Import, paste the full Key=value line into Additional ServerGameInstance Settings (or the leftover box for that heading) or the line is dropped.

World event duration in minutes. This field is not written by AMP Game.ini subsections. After Import, paste the full Key=value line into Additional ServerGameInstance Settings (or the leftover box for that heading) or the line is dropped.

Minutes between world events. This field is not written by AMP Game.ini subsections. After Import, paste the full Key=value line into Additional ServerGameInstance Settings (or the leftover box for that heading) or the line is dropped.

UE units (centimeters) added to ocean height for high tide, low tide, and floods. Default 0. You will not see much difference until about 100. Negative values are allowed. This field is not written by AMP Game.ini subsections, so weather keys are not injected. Paste full lines such as OceanHeightAdd=0 under Additional WeatherControllerBase Settings if you add that heading yourself; AMP does not create an empty Weather heading.
Default true disables the leaderboard. Set false to enable it (highest growth after creatures die or reset to 1.0).

Default true disables revenge-kill protection. Set false to stop players spawning a saved character within 750m of where they died, unless no other spawn is available. Should not apply to resurrection, reincarnation, or fresh spawns.
Default true disables UseRandomName. Set false to allow the command, which is similar to UseIncognito with a randomized name.
SaveSystem bDisableCharacterDeath. If true, Free Roam deaths auto-resurrect with no growth penalty.
If false, fires are disabled. If true, dry wildfires, lava-induced fires, and lightning-induced fires can spawn. Lava-induced fires are bugged.

Keeps flooding from getting too high. Disable to allow superfloods. This field is not written by AMP Game.ini subsections, so weather keys are not injected.
